# Country scope. Axis 1: Solomonic Ethiopia & Horn of Africa Christian realms.
oe_afr_is_ethiopia_axis = {

	OR = {

		tag = MED
		tag = ENN
		tag = HDY
		tag = DAM
		tag = BTI
	}
}

# Country scope. Any African Three-Axis protagonist.
oe_afr_is_protagonist = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		oe_afr_is_ethiopia_axis = yes
		oe_afr_is_sahel_axis = yes
		oe_afr_is_swahili_axis = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Respects Rule #17 oe_rule_global_arcs_depth (0 new rules).
oe_afr_country_enabled = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. Cross-module synergy with v10.0 Ecumenical Religion 2.0 Chalcedon reconciliation (= 2).
oe_afr_has_chalcedon_accord = {
	global_var:oe_rel2_axis_chalcedon ?= 2
}

# Country scope. Cross-module synergy with v12.5 Saharan Scholar Caravan expedition.
oe_afr_has_sahara_caravan = {
	has_variable = oe_nav2_done_sahara
}

# Country scope. Any European power holding territory along the Swahili coast or Sofala.
oe_afr_european_in_swahili = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	num_locations > 0
	capital ?= {
		continent = continent:europe
	}
	any_owned_location = {
		OR = {
			region = region:swahili_coast_region
			this = location:sofala
			this = location:mozambique
			this = location:quelimane
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Any Christian Red Sea / European diplomatic partner for Prester John embassy is alive.
oe_afr_has_prester_john_partner = {

		country_exists = c:ROM
		country_exists = c:PAP
		country_exists = c:POR
	}
}
